1: // Asteroid Dodge – concise implementation targeting canvas#game
2: 
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Ship – simple triangle (rocket) centered vertically
11:   const ship = { x: 40, y: height / 2, size: 20, speed: 4 };
12:   const keys = {};
13:   const asteroids = [];
14:   let score = 0;
15:   let lastSpawn = 0;
16:   let startTime = performance.now();
17:   let gameOver = false;
18: 
19:   // Input handling
20:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
21:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
22: 
23:   function spawnAsteroid() {
24:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
25:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
26:     let x, y, vx, vy;
27:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2;
28:     // spawn on random edge moving inward
29:     if (side === 0) { // left
30:       x = -radius; y = Math.random() * height; vx = speed; vy = 0;
31:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
32:       x = width + radius; y = Math.random() * height; vx = -speed; vy = 0;
33:     } else if (side === 2) { // top
34:       x = Math.random() * width; y = -radius; vx = 0; vy = speed;
35:     } else { // bottom
36:       x = Math.random() * width; y = height + radius; vx = 0; vy = -speed;
37:     }
38:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, vx, vy });
39:   }
40: 
41:   function update(dt) {
42:     // Ship movement
43:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
44:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
45:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
46:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
47:     // Keep ship inside canvas
48:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x));
49:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.size, ship.y));
50: 
51:     // Asteroid spawn
52:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 800) { // approx 1 per sec
53:       spawnAsteroid();
54:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
55:     }
56: 
57:     // Update asteroids
58:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
59:       const a = asteroids[i];
60:       a.x += a.vx;
61:       a.y += a.vy;
62:       // remove off‑screen
63:       if (a.x < -a.radius || a.x > width + a.radius || a.y < -a.radius || a.y > height + a.radius) {
64:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
65:       }
66:     }
67: 
68:     // Collision detection
69:     const shipCx = ship.x + ship.size / 2;
70:     const shipCy = ship.y + ship.size / 2;
71:     for (const a of asteroids) {
72:       const dx = shipCx - a.x;
73:       const dy = shipCy - a.y;
74:       const dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
75:       const radSum = ship.size / 2 + a.radius;
76:       if (dist2 < radSum * radSum) {
77:         gameOver = true;
78:         break;
79:       }
80:     }
81: 
82:     // Score = seconds survived
83:     score = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
84:   }
85: 
86:   function draw() {
87:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
88:     // Ship (blue triangle rocket)
89:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
90:     ctx.beginPath();
91:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.size / 2);
92:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y);
93:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
94:     ctx.closePath();
95:     ctx.fill();
96:     // Asteroids (gray circles)
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
98:     for (const a of asteroids) {
99:       ctx.beginPath();
100:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
101:       ctx.fill();
102:     }
103:     // Score display
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
105:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
106:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
107:     if (gameOver) {
108:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
109:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
110:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
111:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
112:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
113:       ctx.fillText(`Game Over – ${score}s`, width / 2, height / 2);
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   function loop(timestamp) {
118:     if (!gameOver) {
119:       const dt = timestamp - (lastTime || timestamp);
120:       update(dt);
121:       draw();
122:       lastTime = timestamp;
123:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
124:     } else {
125:       draw(); // final frame with overlay
126:     }
127:   }
128:   let lastTime = 0;
129:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
130: })();
